tools.name: verify_labubu_factory_authenticity
tools.description: Verify genuine Pop Mart Labubu V1 Tasty Macarons and V2 Have a Seat factory production batch stamps (Shenzhen, Huizhou, Zhongshan), keyring engraving, inner foil bag seal type, and fabric vs paper tag markers.

tools.name: calculate_blindbox_chase_odds
tools.description: Calculate exact cumulative probability of pulling a Secret Chase figure (1:72, 1:144, or 1:288), expected monetary spend, and sealed whole-case advantage based on number of boxes opened.

tools.name: optimize_blindbox_collection_cost
tools.description: Determine the mathematically optimal acquisition strategy (blind single pulls vs factory-sealed full case vs buying opened desired figures) given remaining uncollected figures in a series.

tools.name: check_blindbox_anti_counterfeit_features
tools.description: Retrieve brand-specific physical inspection points (9-tooth tooth count, matte vinyl blush, UV foot stamp, official hologram QR verification) to spot high-grade counterfeit "Lafufu" replicas.

tools.name: list_popular_blindbox_series_specs
tools.description: List standard case configurations, box counts per sealed display case, Secret chase ratios, and official release references for trending designer blind boxes.
